title: Wellspring Conversations - Videos
description:
Welcome to Wellspring Conversations, a podcast by the Wellspring Center, where real people share real stories and where healing begins through conversation. Hosted by a certified mental health professional, each episode invites anonymous callers to open up about their personal mental health journeys. Whether they’re navigating anxiety, depression, trauma, or everyday emotional struggles, these brave voices shed light on the shared human experience of mental health.

Our host offers compassionate listening, practical insights, and professional guidance—sometimes it’s about solutions, and sometimes it’s simply about being heard. No labels. No judgment. Just honest conversations that remind us we’re not alone.

Disclaimer: This podcast is for educational and informational purposes only and does not replace professional therapy or medical advice. If you’re in crisis, please seek help from a licensed provider or contact emergency services.
